challengeFindings.title: An owner who pins BKIT_TEST_SLOTS=1 in one host's settings still gets two heavy runs at once on an 8+ core machine, because a terminal, another host or a preserved 6.1.1 copy without the pin defaults to 2 and takes tests.2.lock beside the pinned holder

On an 8+ core machine, a plain `pnpm test` or `pnpm test:integration` started while a wrapped gate holds `tests.lock` no longer waits: the Vitest global setup takes `tests.2.lock` at once, but Vitest fixed its worker count before the lock was taken, so it runs cores - 1 workers (9 on 10 cores) beside the other heavy run instead of the 4 the slot count allows
